therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: antipsychotic symptom control and relapse prevention
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Veterans with schizophrenia or schizoaffective disorder
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Hospitalization-free survival (time to first psychiatric re-hospitalization) over 24 months

subgroup_findings: Patients with psychiatric hospitalization at baseline: injectable risperidone n=72, oral n=81
Patients without psychiatric hospitalization at baseline: injectable risperidone n=115, oral n=101
safety_signals: Chest pain reported in 4/187 injectable risperidone patients (SAE)
Death reported in 1/187 injectable risperidone patients (SAE)
Atrial fibrillation, atrial flutter, bradycardia each reported in 1/182 oral antipsychotic patients (SAE)
Abdominal pain, duodenal stenosis, gastrooesophageal reflux disease each reported in 1/187 injectable risperidone patients (SAE)
Irritable bowel syndrome and pancreatitis each reported in 1/182 oral antipsychotic patients (SAE)
